### 🎲 Proposed Event Name
`[e.g. Volcanic Eruption, Electrostatic Storm, Diamond Cascade]`

### 🎯 Target Tier
- [ ] **Tier 1 (Mortal Calamity):** Extreme danger, high lethality risk, intense survival panic.
- [ ] **Tier 2 (Sabotage & Misfortune):** Tripping, tool durability drain, minor/moderate debuffs.
- [ ] **Tier 3 (Neutral Equilibrium):** Cosmetic effects, serene breeze, vanilla balance.
- [ ] **Tier 4 (Favorable Winds):** Moderate blessings, speed buffs, duplicate drops, lifesteal.
- [ ] **Tier 5 (God Mode / Divine):** Massive divine power, transmutations, lightning, supreme loot.

### ⚔️ Action Category
- [ ] **Mining (`MINING`):** Triggered when breaking solid blocks with tools.
- [ ] **Movement (`MOVEMENT`):** Triggered when walking, running, and exploring.
- [ ] **Building (`BLOCK_PLACE`):** Triggered when placing blocks.
- [ ] **Combat (`COMBAT_EXPLORE`):** Triggered when striking mobs or entities.
- [ ] **Crafting (`CRAFTING`):** Triggered when crafting on workstations or inventory.
